Upon initiation of treatment, the most common adverse reactions occurring in this population treated with HUMIRA were injection site pain and injection site reaction (19% and 16%, respectively). A less commonly reported adverse event in subjects receiving HUMIRA was granuloma annulare which did not lead to discontinuation of HUMIRA treatment.

Approximately 15% of subjects treated with HUMIRA developed mild-to-moderate elevations of creatine phosphokinase (CPK) in Study JIA-I. Elevations exceeding 5 times the upper limit of normal were observed in several subjects. CPK concentrations decreased or returned to normal in all subjects.
